note: Motion-capture locomotion of the engine template mannequin (git-ignored engine content restored by Scripts/copy_template_content.sh), played on the shared skeleton. speed_cm_s is the speed the clip was captured at (its root travel over its length; the pose itself is played in place), stride_cm the ground the whole clip covers, cycles the gait cycles it holds, phase_start_s where the left foot first passes the right: see Dink.Animation.NaturalClipSurvey. These names replace the generated clips whose names begin with drop_prefixes. posture is a light layer in degrees (chest rounded forward, head lowered, shoulders drawn forward, upper arms brought in towards the body) for a timid and a confident body. slow_cadence_power says how a body walks slower than the walk clip: 1 keeps the clip's long stride and only slows the cadence, 0 keeps the cadence and only shortens the step (by mixing in the standing pose); Mother takes shorter, quicker steps than Dink. style: see style.note.

style.note: How each body walks against the shared motion capture (DinkFootPlacement.h, FDinkGaitStyle): stride is the step length against the clip (the cadence rises by its inverse, so the speed is kept), width_cm sets each foot further out (+) or in (-), uneven makes one step of each pair longer (share of a step), step_time scales how quick the pivot steps of a turn on the spot are, chest_swing is the gain on the chest turning against the hips while walking. Hero: a timid lad takes short, quick, slightly uneven steps with his knees together and turns round in shuffles; with confidence his stride lengthens, steadies and widens. Mother: short brisk steps, narrow under the skirt. Milder: long heavy steps, a wide stance and a swagger of the shoulders.
